verdict.rationale: Offline sync is a fair question for a reactive database, but the evidence only documents real-time sync and live-updating apps. That is an adjacent capability, not offline local writes that replay on reconnect. A community comment notes that Convex executes queries remotely, while Firestore syncs data locally and so gets better offline behavior. Nothing in the pack shows Convex shipping offline-capable clients with automatic write sync on reconnect.
